head: WORKTREE
summary: Open-account flow is complete across contract, use case, service, JPA adapter, Liquibase and Problem Details handler. Tests pass (67/67) and cover each criterion. Only minor test-coverage gaps remain.

acceptance_criteria.evidence: OpenAccountIT#openedAccountHasUniqueIdGivenCurrencyAndZeroBalance, #openAccountResponseCarriesTheAccountAndItsLocation (type/normal side/zero balance); AccountPersistenceAdapterIT#savedAccountIsStoredWithItsAttributesAndAnInitialVersion; OpenAccountServiceTest. Empty movement list deferred to T-005 per brief.

AccountControllerTest#invalidRequestIsRejectedAsProblemDetails (missing currency, lowercase, unknown type, missing policy, malformed JSON) and #wellFormedButUnknownCurrencyCodeIsRejectedAsProblemDetails; OpenAccountIT#unknownCurrencyIsRejectedAsProblemDetailsAndNothingIsStored.

changes/0001-create-accounts.yaml (uuid pk, char(3), type, overdraft_policy, version, created_at, CHECK constraints); ddl-auto validate; AccountPersistenceAdapterIT row/version/constraint tests; test-summary pass.

findings.description: B2 names an unknown overdraft policy value, but only an unknown type and a missing policy are tested.
findings.suggestion: Add an unknown overdraftPolicy value (e.g. SOMETIMES) to the parameterized invalid-request cases.

findings.description: The end-to-end test does not read back the persisted type/overdraft_policy for an account created over HTTP; this is only covered at adapter level.
findings.suggestion: Assert the stored row's type and overdraft_policy in the HTTP IT.

findings.description: No fallback handler for unexpected exceptions, so a 500 is not guaranteed to be Problem Details.
findings.suggestion: Consider a generic Exception handler returning a 500 problem without internals, perhaps in a later task.
